notes.title: May 27th Small Update
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Fixed HP/MP damage numbers appearing as decimals
[*] Removed 'Optimize' command for equipment
[*] Removed animations for status effects, since they seemed to slow the game down
[*] Added the Nanoblade fusion (Felid Paw + Liquid Manipulation IV + Grindstone Skin + Strong Plasmid)
[*] Added the transcend Fury Fire to the Salvo Shooter, Aquillafer, and Exvitation mutagenes
[*] Added the skill Kairotic Strike to the Enhanced Reflexes, Wild Assassination, and Way of the Jungle mutagenes
[/list]
